vulnerability.name: USN-5066-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5066-1 fixed a vulnerability in PySAML2. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Brian Wolff discovered that PySAML2 incorrectly validated cryptographic  signatures. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to alter SAML  documents.

statements.status_notes: PySAML2 could be made to accept invalid SAML documents. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
